name: SmartRestart
description: Instant restart only before a chosen percentage. Toggle with a keybind.

enabled.name: Enable Smart Restart
enabled.description: Instantly restart when dying before the selected percentage.

restart-percent.name: Restart up to
restart-percent.description: Deaths at or below this percentage restart instantly.

toggle-key.name: Toggle key
toggle-key.description: Key used to toggle Smart Restart during gameplay.

restart-delay.name: Restart delay
restart-delay.description: How long to wait before restarting.
